title: Palace iOS — Architecture Field Notes
subtitle: The architectural spine: one DI root, a unidirectional Store where it counts, a single-source-of-truth registry, and three coexisting dialects. Every claim below re-resolves to live source.

tenets.title: Single source of truth
tenets.detail: TPPBookRegistry owns book state; everyone else observes it.

tenets.title: Pure reducers where it counts
tenets.detail: Critical state machines extracted into reduce(&state, action) -> Effect.

tenets.title: DI through one root
tenets.detail: AppContainer is the sole composition root; new code avoids .shared.

tenets.title: Contracts, snapshotted
tenets.detail: Ordered side-effect sequences locked as JSON that fails loudly on drift.

tenets.title: Mutation-tested critical paths
tenets.detail: Sign-in, borrow, download, DRM: every branch tested, every test kills a mutant.

tenets.title: A trustworthy green board
tenets.detail: Flakes retried, pollution fixed at root, the tooling itself under CI.

tenets.title: Read-only projections outward
tenets.detail: @Published private(set) and Combine publishers; state flows out, never reached into.

nodes.name: AppContainer
nodes.summary: Composition root. Builds the DI graph once via production(), cached behind OSAllocatedUnfairLock; injected via SwiftUI EnvironmentKey.

nodes.name: Store<State,Action,Environment>
nodes.summary: @MainActor final class ObservableObject; @Published private(set) state; send / sendAwait. No scope/pullback/TestStore.

nodes.name: TPPBookRegistry
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for book state; facade over store/sync/bookmark; projects registryPublisher / bookStatePublisher / syncStatePublisher.

nodes.name: HoldsReducer
nodes.summary: Pure reducer; .searchQueryChanged returns a real .task awaiting env.filterBooks.

nodes.name: BorrowReducer
nodes.summary: Pure FSM (button/progress/return-stickiness); every branch returns .none; BookDetailViewModel still owns effects.

nodes.name: TPPNetworkExecutor
nodes.summary: executor -> NetworkTransport -> TPPNetworkResponder -> NYPLResult<Data>; proactive token refresh.

nodes.name: NetworkQueue
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed offline retry queue; retries on reachability, max 5 attempts.

nodes.name: MyBooksDownloadCenter
nodes.summary: Imperative download pipeline; owns BorrowOperation / DownloadStartCoordinator / DownloadStartDispatcher / BookReturnService.

nodes.name: BorrowOperation
nodes.summary: borrowAsync — the ordered borrow contract (fetchBook then startDownload).

nodes.name: BookReturnService
nodes.summary: returnBook — the ordered return contract; offline OfflineAction(.return) branch.

nodes.name: NavigationCoordinator
nodes.summary: @MainActor ObservableObject; @Published NavigationPath + AppRoute enum; bridged to non-SwiftUI via NavigationCoordinatorHub.

nodes.name: AppTabRouter
nodes.summary: @MainActor ObservableObject; @Published selected: AppTab; AppTabRouterHub survives router dealloc.

nodes.name: AudiobookSessionManager
nodes.summary: @MainActor final class ObservableObject behind AudiobookSessionManaging; owns load->bind->play lifecycle. Different dialect from Store.

nodes.name: AudiobookSessionPresenter
nodes.summary: Root presenter mirroring session state; drives the Palace-owned morphing player.

nodes.name: in_app_playback_nav_enabled
nodes.summary: Firebase Remote Config flag, default OFF; local UserDefaults override wins. Gates the in-app morphing player vs the legacy pushed route.

flows.title: BookReturnService.returnBook — return critical path
steps: offline branch: OfflineAction(.return) enqueued; NO local cleanup until server-confirmed

manifest.claim: Every BorrowReducer branch returns .none; the ViewModel still owns effects. If a .task appears here, the 'shape-only' label is a lie.
HoldsReducer.searchQueryChanged returns a real async .task — the one effectful branch behind its 'full adoption' label.
Store exposes no scope()/child-store composition; the Habicht-vs-Palace 'no composition layer' verdict depends on this staying true.
Auth uses its own Effect copy (no Sendable constraint) — there is not one canonical Effect 'spine'.
Book state is single-source for LOANS, but sideloaded books have a separate registry — 'single source of truth' is scoped, not absolute.
